defect: A lost database COMMIT response previously caused unconditional deletion of an already uploaded file, even when its READY material transaction had committed.
fix: Resolve the exact material receipt after serializing with the save's owned parent-session lock. Confirmed receipt returns READY without another write; conclusive absence permits compensation; unknown/unavailable/hidden/conflicting outcome preserves the object and returns controlled FILE_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
guards: READ COMMITTED checked before trusting absence
parent lock before separate fresh receipt snapshot
3 second lock timeout and 5 second statement timeout
no private key, filename, text, token or upstream error logged
no save retry or Storage upsert
